reuse.why: Reuses getCategoriesWithTemplates, isTrackingBudget, getSheetValue, setBudget and batchMessages, and the new action takes its category set from a new shared selection helper that the 3/6/12-month actions now also use; setZero and copyPreviousMonth are left on their own selection.

duplication.why: The expense sign flip (`if (cat.is_income === 0) amount *= -1`) is copied from setNMonthAvg/set3MonthAvg rather than shared, and setZero keeps its own copy of the selection query and filters next to the new helper.

placement.why: Action lives in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Beyond the new action, the diff rewrites set3/6/12MonthAvg (set3MonthAvg now goes through setNMonthAvg with awaited nested batches), an unrequested refactor that changes existing code paths.

maintainability.why: Extracting getMonthWideCategories is a real improvement and the new action is short, but the selection rule is now in one helper used by some actions while setZero and copyPreviousMonth still carry their own versions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: New action uses the new getMonthWideCategories helper and existing sheet/budget helpers; no existing abstraction is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated sign flip in setLastMonthSpending is a plain copy of the setNMonthAvg idiom, not disguised.
